authority: AUTHORITATIVE machine rules for the judgment gates. .claude/skills/gate/ref-gate-tables.md mirrors this file for humans; on conflict THIS file wins. Verdict logic is implemented in tools/gate-eval.py against the parameters below; both are version-locked via schema_version.

f.name: trade-generation discipline (anti-FOMO / anti-panic)
f.subject: a proposed ADD / TRIM / EXIT action on a specific instrument
f.division_of_labor: GATE-F checks behavioral/temporal PROCESS markers only. Doctrine ceilings and R/R live in /invest Phase Q + K-bis; execution-time numbers and the sleep-gate live in tools/pretrade_gate.py. GATE-F never rechecks those.

tenure_days.fill_rule: days between the ticker's entity note created: date (wiki/entities/tickers/<T>.md) and today; 0 if no entity note exists

held_position.fill_rule: true iff the entity note frontmatter accounts: list is non-empty

catalyst_age_hours.fill_rule: hours since the NEWEST dated event cited in the proposal's own rationale (adversarially conservative: newest = most FOMO-flagging)

prior_analysis_days.fill_rule: days since the latest wiki/investing/analyses/<ticker>-analysis-*.md; null if none. An in-flight full /invest run counts as 0.

thesis_member.fill_rule: entity frontmatter thesis: list non-empty. CONTEXT ONLY in v1 -- recorded, not scored.

regime_alert.fill_rule: true iff latest briefing meta.json indices_snapshot shows VIX >= 20 OR VIX term_structure == backwardation

move_5d_pct.fill_rule: absolute % move over the last 5 regular sessions, regular-close anchored; prov mcp:* > script:*

trades_7d.fill_rule: count of prior gate-f sheets (verdict != BLOCKED) in trailing 7 days PLUS execute-or-decline.md rows flipped to EXECUTED with a trade action in-window

after_hours_origination.fill_rule: true iff the proposal's pricing or urgency rests on extended-hours quotes rather than regular-close-anchored data (doctrine: extended-hours prices never trigger doctrine evaluations); an evening run anchored to the regular close is FALSE

trigger_backed.fill_rule: true iff a GATE-T sheet with verdict FIRED exists whose trigger action covers this instrument

zone_preregistered.fill_rule: true iff the latest analysis frontmatter for the instrument carries a watch_zone whose set_on is >= 14 days before today, whose low/high are UNCHANGED since set_on (zone_prior comparison, or a single unmoved block), and where the price entered the zone FROM ABOVE (prior regular close > high, current regular close inside [low, high]); prov = the analysis path. OPTIONAL marker under schema_version 1 (absent == false): sheets written before 2026-07-30 validate unchanged.

rules_ordered: 1. trigger_backed AND action_side in {TRIM, EXIT} -> DISCIPLINED (trigger-driven exits are the system working)
1b. zone_preregistered AND action_side == ADD -> DISCIPLINED (a pre-registered zone firing is the plan working, not FOMO; buy-side parity with rule 1, short-circuits BEFORE fomo_points scoring)
2. fomo_points >= 4, OR (tenure point fires AND prior_analysis_days is null AND catalyst_age_hours < 24) -> BLOCKED
fomo_points = count of: catalyst_age_hours < 48; (NOT held_position AND tenure_days < 14); (prior_analysis_days null OR > 30); regime_alert; move_5d_pct >= 10; after_hours_origination; trades_7d >= 3

mandate_meanings.cooling-off-48h: no ratification of the action for 48 hours from sheet date
mandate_meanings.eod-row-regate: append an execute-or-decline.md row naming the re-gate, ESCALATION_DATE = sheet date + 2
mandate_meanings.tranche-cap-25pct-on-regate: if the re-gate returns DISCIPLINED, first tranche capped at 25% of intended size (fraction only -- never record dollars or share counts on a gate sheet)
mandate_meanings.no-recommendation: no BUY/SELL recommendation may be emitted for the instrument
mandate_meanings.invest-and-challenge-required: a full /invest run AND a /challenge are prerequisites to any re-gate
mandate_meanings.regate-min-5td: re-gate no earlier than 5 trading days after sheet date

t.name: trigger-fired adjudication (manual/evidence triggers only)
t.subject: one trigger_id from a thesis triggers: block where source == manual or the metric needs evidence interpretation (earnings_window)
t.division_of_labor: Numeric machine triggers (operator/threshold computable) are evaluated mechanically by /brief Phase H and are OUT OF SCOPE for GATE-T.

trigger_id.fill_rule: must exist in the named thesis file's triggers block

tier.fill_rule: the trigger's tier in the thesis block

evidence.fill_rule: each item: source domain/path, grade A-D per the 8.6 evidence-grading rules with freshness downgrades, ISO date, one-line statement

metric_condition_met.fill_rule: numeric restatement of the trigger condition against the evidence; the restatement itself goes in the sheet body

window_ok.fill_rule: all counted evidence dates inside the trigger's window field

consecutive_required.fill_rule: the trigger's counter requirement (e.g. consecutive quarters); null when not a counter trigger

consecutive_count.fill_rule: observed consecutive count; null when not a counter trigger

rules_ordered: 1. fewer than 2 evidence items of grade A|B from 2+ distinct sources -> INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE
2. metric_condition_met AND window_ok AND (consecutive_count >= consecutive_required when consecutive_required is not null) -> FIRED

mandate_meanings.status-floor-kill: thesis INVALIDATED-candidate + mandatory /decide; fired: stamp lands via the existing /brief Pattern-20 write-back with this sheet as the evidence record
mandate_meanings.status-floor-red: thesis status floor STRESSED via the existing Pattern-20 path; this sheet is the evidence record
mandate_meanings.status-floor-amber: thesis status floor WATCH via the existing Pattern-20 path; this sheet is the evidence record
mandate_meanings.status-floor-manual: surface to the user for review; manual triggers carry no automatic floor
mandate_meanings.eod-row-trigger-action: append an execute-or-decline.md row for the trigger's action: field, ESCALATION_DATE = sheet date + 3
mandate_meanings.eod-row-evidence-collection: append an execute-or-decline.md evidence-collection row, ESCALATION_DATE = sheet date + 3

b.name: build-vs-ship discriminator
b.subject: a proposal to create new runtime/tooling artifacts (skill, script, hook, workflow, index)
b.division_of_labor: The 30-day BUILD-gate consumption doctrine and the EOD ledger already exist; GATE-B feeds them and never duplicates their bookkeeping.

closes_eod_id.fill_rule: the execute-or-decline.md row ID this build closes; null if none

overdue_eod_count.fill_rule: count of PENDING rows past ESCALATION_DATE in execute-or-decline.md as of today

user_directive.fill_rule: true iff the user explicitly requested this build in their own words this session

similar_organ.fill_rule: vault path of the nearest existing artifact serving the same function; null if none

similar_organ_consumed_30d.fill_rule: evidence of reads/invocations of similar_organ in the last 30 days; null when similar_organ is null

size_class.fill_rule: estimated new lines: S < 50, M 50-200, L > 200

rules_ordered: 1. similar_organ not null AND similar_organ_consumed_30d == false -> DECLINE (no v2 of an unused organ; cite it)
2. user_directive -> BUILD-JUSTIFIED (user overrules; the sheet makes displaced work visible)
BUILD-JUSTIFIED extras: size_class L adds consumption-review-30d; overdue_eod_count >= 1 adds list-displaced-eod-rows

mandate_meanings.resolve-top-overdue-eod-first: the top-weighted overdue EOD row must be EXECUTED or explicitly DECLINED (dated Resolution) before the build proceeds
mandate_meanings.regate-after: re-run GATE-B after the EOD row resolves
mandate_meanings.consumption-review-30d: registry entry gets review_date = sheet date + 30; if no consumption evidence by then, the artifact is an archive candidate
mandate_meanings.list-displaced-eod-rows: the sheet body must list the overdue EOD rows this build displaces (visibility, not blockage)
